draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.19, the 98th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 12th of 31 at WR. He lasted until pick 136, well after his grade rank (98th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing concerns: 10-yard split (12th percentile). College production: 831 receiving yards in 2024, 17th of 31 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans. 16 career games and 14 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 4 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: team target share 16.8% (77th percentile). Weak spots: catch rate 46.1% (3rd percentile), yards per target 5.8 (10th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 wide receiver who played: 515 receiving yards against a median of 198, above the norm.
